facts: Critical incidents must be acknowledged within fifteen minutes.
The incident commander owns the response timeline.
Security incidents are escalated to the security duty officer.
A post-incident review is due within five business days.
Customer status updates are sent every thirty minutes during an outage.
Production access requires approval from a service owner.
Privileged access expires after eight hours.
All administrator accounts require a hardware security key.
User access is reviewed every calendar quarter.
Departed employee access must be removed within one hour.
Database backups run daily at 02:00 UTC.
Daily backup retention is thirty days.
Backup restoration drills happen every month.
The recovery point objective is twenty-four hours.
The recovery time objective is four hours.
Confidential documents must be encrypted at rest with AES-256.
Customer export links expire after forty-eight hours.
Personal data deletion requests are completed within thirty calendar days.
Restricted data may only be stored in the approved regional vault.
The privacy lead approves new personal data processing purposes.
Normal releases are scheduled on Tuesdays at 10:00 UTC.
Every production release needs two peer approvals.
Canary deployments initially serve five percent of traffic.
A release is rolled back when the error rate exceeds two percent.
Emergency releases require approval from the engineering duty manager.
The standard support desk operates from 08:00 to 18:00 UTC.
Priority one support tickets have a response target of ten minutes.
Priority two tickets have a response target of two hours.
Support ticket attachments are deleted after ninety days.
The support lead reviews unresolved tickets every morning.
Company laptops are replaced every four years.
Lost equipment must be reported within two hours of discovery.
Full disk encryption is mandatory on every company laptop.
Equipment returns are handled by the workplace operations team.
Laptop operating system updates are installed within seven days.
Vendors handling customer data receive a security review annually.
The procurement lead owns the vendor inventory.
New vendor contracts require a signed data processing agreement.
High risk vendor findings must be remediated within fourteen days.
Vendor offboarding includes deleting integration credentials.
The monthly service availability target is 99.9 percent.
Health probes run every sixty seconds.
Capacity forecasts are reviewed on the first Monday of each month.
Application error logs are retained for twenty-one days.
On-call rotations change every Wednesday at 09:00 UTC.
Expense claims must be filed within twenty days of travel.
International travel requires director approval.
Economy class is the default for company flights.
Itemized receipts are required for meal reimbursement.
The finance team pays approved expenses every Friday.
